title: Big B & Double Trouble | Thomas UNHINGED Shorts
titleVi: Đại Ca Big B & Rắc Rối Nhân Đôi | Hoạt Hình 3D Hài Hước
fullText: Hold the brake! Look out! Where are we? Uh-oh. Well, if it isn't Thomas himself. Boy, we've been waiting for a moment like this! Stop bullying me. Is there a problem here? Whoa, who are you? They call me Big B. Well Big B, how do you suppose I make it past all these troublesome trucks? Don't worry about it, no need to get crazy. Am I late for the meeting? Big B, what are you doing here? Go back! No, he just saved me, we need him. Well, I guess it's been long enough, you can stay. Thanks Mr. Hatt. Listen, now that Big B is back, I need you to keep an eye on him. Can you do that? Of course I can. Now I don't know what trouble is to come, but I'll be there to handle it!
